title: Assistance to writers on low incomes and/or from communities under represented in publishing
use_cases: Apply for a free place on online tutorials when based in the UK and on a low income
Apply for Q&A session assistance when belonging to a community under-represented in publishing
Provide proof of eligibility for financial support using government benefit documentation
Submit a writer bio and career summary to the BPA team for scholarship consideration
content:
We are offering a free place on each of our online tutorials and Q & A sessions for UK based writers on low incomes and/or from under represented communities in publishing.

Writers may apply for a free place on one of the sessions by contacting BPA with a short bio and a summary of their writing career to date.

Please click here to Contact BPA with your application and in the case of writers on low incomes, proof of financial eligibility such as: Jobseeker’s Allowance; Disability Benefit; Income Support; Working Tax Credit; Child Tax Credit; Proof of being a full-time student; Housing benefit; Proof of being a full-time carer.

All details will be kept confidential. Decisions on who receives the free places rest with the BPA team not the tutors.[/vc_column_text][vc_empty_space height=”60px”][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner][vc_basic_grid post_type=”post” max_items=”5″ gap=”5″ item=”masonryGrid_Default” grid_id=”vc_gid:1638056010263-cbf95665-1686-6″ taxonomies=”333″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]
